reasons: Rule applies: this is a master services agreement, and the cited termination provisions (p0032-p0033) address only accrued fees and assignment of Works in progress — no transition assistance, data return, or deletion/certification mechanic, so a 'missing' classification is correct.

The insert is actionable and tracks the model language closely (6 months' assistance at then-current rates, 30-day return in machine-readable format, deletion plus written certification), adapted to the document's defined terms (Contractor/Company, Works, Confidential Information, Statement of Work).
Edit is additive only — no existing counterparty-favourable language is disturbed — and is placed as a new Section 6(c) in the termination section, matching the redline guidance.

Comment is concise, first person plural, cites the playbook position and offers the 90-day fallback, consistent with tone requirements; deterministic checks confirm the operation applies and data return/transition text is present.
